title: Explicit solvers with constraints: coordinate constraints eliminated in the symbolic SolveExplicit, Euler parameters by projection after each step
author: Claude-JG
description: The C++ explicit solver eliminates CoordinateConstraints to the ground (explicit.eliminateConstraints) and refuses other constraints; the symbolic SolveExplicit refuses every algebraic equation; nodes with Euler parameters are refused by explicit solvers, as their norm is an algebraic equation. Decided (maintainer 2026-11-04, revision2026c step RG16.5): the elimination of coordinate constraints also in the symbolic SolveExplicit, in line with C++; Euler parameters in explicit solvers by the projection onto the unit norm after each step, without raising for their constraint, with a possible drift of momentum and energy; the analysis first (docs/dev/design/advancedSolvers.md section 3.5).
releaseNotes: SolveExplicit of exudyn.symbolics.solvers eliminates algebraic equations that fix one coordinate each, as Exudyn's explicit solver eliminates CoordinateConstraints to the ground, and integrates rigid bodies on Euler parameters with their constraint on acceleration level and the projection of the parameters onto the unit norm after each step. UserItemCreator.CreateRigidBody creates the user rigid body on a NodeRigidBodyEP (the default) or a NodeRigidBodyRxyz, and SymbolicSystem takes the algebraic equation of the Euler parameter nodes.
